name: pi-telegram-echo
description: Voice echo extension for the Pi coding agent + @llblab/pi-telegram bridge. Adds the 🎙️ reply showing the STT transcript of inbound voice/audio messages. STT is delegated to a peer-dep provider extension (default: pi-whisper-stt; alternative: pi-openai-stt for any OpenAI-compatible API gateway) selected via extensions.pi-telegram-echo.stt_provider in telegram.json. The section is registered once per session so the in-Telegram menu buttons stay stable across hot-reloads.
